equip_load.description: The weight this build can carry.

load_remaining.description: equip_load minus equipped_weight: unused capacity. Negative means overloaded.

weight_before_roll_change.description: How much more can be carried before the roll drops to the next category — the threshold is a share of the cap, not all of it. This is the figure to quote for 'can I still pick up X'.

encumbrance_percent.description: Share of the load used, as the planner rounds it.

roll.description: The roll this leaves: Light Load, Med. Load, Heavy Load, or Overloaded.

end_for_light_roll.description: Endurance needed to light-roll with this loadout. Zero means unreachable even at 99 — drop weight instead.

end_for_mid_roll.description: Endurance needed to medium-roll with this loadout. Zero means unreachable.

talismans_modelled.description: Always false. The Build Planner port does not model talisman effects, so this figure is before Great-Jar's Arsenal and its like. Say so when it could change the answer.
